sql: SELECT A.AE_APPLID,A.AE_DISABLE_RESTART,A.TEMPTBLINSTANCES,S.AE_STATE_RECNAME,S.AE_DEFAULT_STATE FROM PSAEAPPLDEFN A LEFT JOIN PSAEAPPLSTATE S ON S.AE_APPLID=A.AE_APPLID WHERE A.AE_APPLID='GM_DEPT_XL5'; SELECT AE_APPLID,RECNAME FROM PSAEAPPLTEMPTBL WHERE AE_APPLID='GM_DEPT_XL5'; SELECT S.AE_APPLID,S.AE_SECTION,S.AE_STEP,S.AE_STMT_TYPE,S.SQLID,T.SQLTEXT FROM PSAESTMTDEFN S LEFT JOIN PSSQLTEXTDEFN T ON T.SQLID=S.SQLID WHERE S.AE_APPLID='GM_DEPT_XL5' ORDER BY S.AE_STEP; SELECT OBJECTVALUE1,OBJECTVALUE6,PROGLEN FROM PSPCMPROG WHERE OBJECTVALUE1='GM_DEPT_XL5'; SELECT PROGSEQ,DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(PCTEXT) CHARS,DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(PCTEXT,2000,1) PART1,DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(PCTEXT,2000,2001) PART2,DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(PCTEXT,2000,4001) PART3 FROM PSPCMTXT WHERE OBJECTVALUE1='GM_DEPT_XL5' AND OBJECTVALUE6='Step02' ORDER BY PROGSEQ
